description: This file contains SCSS mixins for creating various gradient backgrounds, including linear, radial, striped, and directional gradients.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: Creates a gradient background with optional enabling based on $enable-gradients variable.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient from left to right with customizable start and end colors and positions.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient from top to bottom with customizable start and end colors and positions.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient at a specified degree between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a three-color linear gradient from left to right with custom color stops.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a three-color linear gradient from top to bottom with custom color stops.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with specified inner and outer colors.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern with customizable color and angle.
